name: Burning Inferno

gist.Heat Wave: Burns every target on the board except the caster, for the rest of the game; targets already burning take a heavy hit instead.
gist.Luna Pele, the Flame Dancer: Draws a card each time something is set on fire, several times a turn.
gist.Alex, Trainer of Heroes: Spreads Abilities to his team-mates; this is how Destruction Magic reaches level three.
gist.Barker, the Monster Tamer: Starts the game with a small creature in play.
gist.Luna Kiai: Creature that sets the deck's own heroes on fire on purpose; while it stands, their maximum health grows each time they take burn damage.
gist.Dichotomy of Luna and Tempeste: Attachment: the deck's own burning targets take half damage from everything except the burn.
gist.Heart of the Mountain: Draws a card for every burning target on the board.
gist.Candlestick Squire: Free creature (by curing one burn) that draws a card per burning target each turn.
gist.Grunge Harpyformer: Free summon that fetches Destruction Magic and can discard one to burn a target.
gist.Goff, the Burnbringer: Once a Gon hero card is tucked under it: burn damage on your side is doubled.
gist.Mountain Tear River: Trap: burns whoever targets its hero.
gist.Boiling Oil: Light damage to your whole side.
gist.Dance of the Flame Pillars: Hits several targets, more for each different Destruction spell in the discard pile.
gist.Fireshield: Reaction: returns part of a hit.
gist.Divine Gift of Fire: Once per game: one side burns for good.

plan: Everything burns, the deck's own heroes included. Heat Wave, Divine Gift of Fire and the Harpyformers set the table alight; Luna Pele, Candlestick Squires and Heart of the Mountain turn every burning target into cards, Luna Kiai and Dichotomy make the deck's own burns nearly harmless, and Goff with Gon underneath doubles yours. A second Heat Wave then hits everything that is already on fire. Until Luna Kiai and Dichotomy are in place it hurts itself as much as you, and it has no way to stop a faster clock.

looks.early: A Grunge Harpyformer, one burning hero on each side, Luna Pele drawing.
looks.mid: The whole table on fire, Luna Kiai keeping its own heroes comfortable, a fat hand.
looks.late: Goff doubling your burns, a second Heat Wave in hand.

opening.tell: Its own heroes are burning too and nothing protects them from it yet.
opening.why: Before Luna Kiai and Dichotomy arrive the fire costs it exactly what it costs you, and you have the Storm on top.

midgame.tell: Luna Kiai stands beside its heroes and a Dichotomy is attached: its own burn has become harmless.
midgame.why: Those two cards make mutual fire one-sided; remove them (The Yeeting, Dark Gear) and the race is level again.

crisis.tell: Your heroes are all burning, Goff has a hero card under it, and a second Heat Wave is due.
crisis.why: Heat Wave only punishes targets already on fire: Tea moves a burn onto its side, shields and healing take the hit, and Goff can be frozen or stolen.

endgame.tell: Both sides are low and burning.
endgame.why: Burn ticks on everyone at once; whoever adds real damage on top wins, and that is the Storm.

opening.board: A Grunge Harpyformer burns your caster; an Angry Cheese has cost its own hero health.
Divine Gift of Fire: your whole side burns for the rest of the duel.

Heart of the Mountain and two Candlestick Squires draw it a new hand.
